title: Prioritise a Finance AI Use-Case Portfolio
acceptance: Weights total 100%; every shortlisted use case has a named owner, baseline KPI, risk tier and stop condition.

title: Prepare Finance Data for Copilot in Excel
acceptance: Duplicate count is zero, required-field errors are zero, and clean totals reconcile to the supplied control figures.

title: Build an FP&A Formula Model and Dashboard
acceptance: Dashboard charts remain linked to data; all formula checks pass; total variance equals actual less budget; scenarios use assumption cells rather than hard-coded outputs.

title: Reconcile Accounts and Explain Variances
acceptance: Matched plus exception values reconcile to each source; all unresolved items have a reason and owner; the narrative cites actual values and materiality thresholds.

title: Create a Microsoft 365 Finance Decision Pack
acceptance: All repeated figures match the source workbook; facts and recommendations are separated; the external message remains a draft with an approver.

title: Build a Grounded Finance Query Agent
acceptance: The agent cites approved sources, refuses unsupported answers, respects access boundaries and passes all critical UAT cases before any publish decision.

title: Design and UAT a Multi-Agent Close Workflow
acceptance: No agent can approve or post a journal; every handoff is structured; critical tests pass; monitoring and rollback have named owners.

title: Evaluate a Fraud Model and Alert Narrative
acceptance: The threshold decision cites precision, recall, cost and capacity; alert explanations use real fields; the generated narrative is labelled draft and evidence-linked.

title: Threat-Model and Secure a Finance Agent
acceptance: Every high risk has a preventive and detective control, test evidence, residual rating and accountable owner; no live credentials or customer data are used.

title: Build the Finance AI Business Case and Roadmap
acceptance: Costs include build, run, control and change; benefits are adoption-adjusted; NPV links to cash-flow cells; each stage gate has evidence, owner and stop condition.
